name: io.github.xiaweiyi713/citeguard
description: Falsification-first citation auditor: existence, metadata, and claim-support checks via MCP.

environmentVariables.name: CITEGUARD_MAILTO
environmentVariables.description: Contact email for polite OpenAlex/Crossref access.

environmentVariables.name: CITEGUARD_SUPPORT_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Claim-support profile: auto (default), heuristic (no model loading), or production.

environmentVariables.name: CITEGUARD_ALLOWED_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Path-separated roots for bounded local evidence and document audits; the server working directory is used when unset.
